premise.claim: Editing spec.worker.tieredStore on an existing CacheRuntime updates the runtime ConfigMap but not the worker Pod (tmpfs sizeLimit / memory limits stay at creation-time values), and no event, condition or log line reports the split (issue #6192).
premise.reportedComponent: pkg/ddc/cache/engine (CacheRuntime sync: cm.go generateRuntimeConfigData, sync.go syncRuntimeSpec)
premise.patchedComponent: pkg/ddc/cache/engine/sync.go + engine.go (drift detection and warning event)
premise.evidence: TestPremiseTieredStoreSplitWorker on base 86e3adf3: after editing the quota 8Gi->16Gi the ConfigMap runtime.json carries 16Gi while the worker ASTS volume tiered-store-level-0-memory keeps sizeLimit 8Gi, and the recorder saw zero events. See results/unit-base.txt.

findings.note: Round 3 (head 6809f62): ledger TS-DISPATCH-PRECEDENCE / Copilot C4368713436. The CRD has no one-of validation on a tieredStore level, so a level can carry both hostPath and emptyDir; extractTieredStoreLevels (cm.go) reports such a level as hostPath, so the drift dispatch must agree. Fixed this round by reordering checkWorkerTieredStoreDrift to HostPath-before-EmptyDir. Bite-checked: with the pre-fix order (EmptyDir first) this test fails with 'both-fields level edit was not reported' (the emptyDir values are unchanged, so the emptyDir branch finds no drift and the missing hostPath volume is never checked).

liveNote: L3 (skipped per round policy: unit + integration only): patch spec.worker.tieredStore quota on a live CacheRuntime (mooncake/curvine gha-e2e fixture) and check 'kubectl get events --field-selector reason=RuntimeTieredStoreConflict' re-emits within 10 minutes while the split persists.
